description.p: A Linux paint editor with brushes, shapes, text, selections and undoable image transformations. Open PNG, JPEG, BMP and WebP images and export copies with explicit transparency and quality choices.
Core editing works offline without accounts or telemetry. This early version has no layers or crash recovery.
Pixel rulers, optional smart guides, expanded Save As formats, drawing opacity, matching-color fill, region zoom and refined controls. Improved canvas background extension and glass setup.
Raster layers and OpenRaster projects, a glass layer panel, invert colors, zoom slider and right-drag canvas navigation.

Magic-wand color selection, selected-text font formatting, spline drawing, refined eraser and toolbar controls, a separate welcome and glass setup, and simpler automatic update checks. Unavailable glass uses opaque surfaces.
Translucent windows and layered frosted menus, persistent theme preferences, clearer dark controls, blinking text caret and automatic smooth fill edges. Desktop blur requires compositor support.
Adjustable glass appearance, improved selection and canvas resizing, same-color fill edge cleanup, and optional stable-release notifications. Update installation remains manual.
Single-layer editor with Ubuntu desktop installation and versioned Linux downloads. Layers, recovery and automatic updates remain future work.
First useful alpha with drawing, selections, image transformations and static image interchange.
